Trends & Innovation: Du hast ein Auge auf neue Werbeformen und bringst eigene Ideen direkt auf die Straße.

Flexible Arbeitszeiten: Gestalte deinen Arbeitstag so, wie er zu deinem Leben passt – dank Vertrauensarbeitszeit und Gleitzeit.

Volle Mobilität: Mit dem Deutschlandticket bist du bundesweit flexibel und umweltfreundlich unterwegs.

Was die Rolle spannend macht?
In dieser Rolle hast du die Möglichkeit, die strategische Weiterentwicklung einer Challenger Brand aktiv mitzugestalten und direkten Einfluss auf Wachstum und Markenwahrnehmung zu nehmen.

Du arbeitest an hochsichtbaren Kampagnen, bewegst dich an der Schnittstelle von Strategie und Kreativität und bringst eigene Ideen mit echter Ownership auf die Straße.

Besonders spannend ist die Kombination aus unternehmerischer Verantwortung, internationalem Scale-up-Mindset und der Chance, Markenarbeit in einem sich schnell entwickelnden Mobilitätsmarkt nachhaltig zu prägen.

Reisevorteile: 12 kostenlose Flix-Gutscheine + 12 Rabattgutscheine für Freunde & Familie.

Lernen & Entwicklung: Nutze Sprachkurse, Schulungen und Experten-Sessions, um deine Fähigkeiten auszubauen.
Mentoring-Programm: Vernetze dich mit erfahrenen Kollegen, um Einblicke zu gewinnen und deine Karriere zu beschleunigen.
Warum Teil von Flix werden?
Bei Flix konzentrieren wir uns darauf, Reisen einfach, sicher und erschwinglich zu gestalten – sowohl für unsere Passagiere als auch für unsere Mitarbeiter. Hier geht es schnell voran, und es gibt viel Raum, etwas zu bewegen. Wir wachsen und entwickeln uns täglich weiter und suchen Menschen, die bereit sind, sich einzubringen und die Art und Weise, wie wir arbeiten, mitzugestalten.
Wenn du einen Job suchst, in dem du wachsen und etwas bewirken kannst, dann bist du bei FlixTrain genau richtig. Hier kannst du Teil eines Teams werden, in dem dein Beitrag zählt und du deine Reise selbst gestalten kannst!

Apaleo is the world's most open, API-first property management platform powering the next generation of hospitality operations. As the hospitality industry enters the age of Agentic AI, where autonomous agents handle everything from revenue optimisation to guest communication, we need someone who can translate our deep technical capabilities into compelling, differentiated value for every segment and market we serve.
As a Senior Product Marketing Manager at Apaleo, you connect the dots between our platform, our market, and the teams that bring both together. You build deep product knowledge and turn it into sharp, differentiated positioning that helps us win in the segments and markets we focus on.
You work closely with our existing content team, adding product and solution depth to what they create. But your impact goes beyond content. You orchestrate how Revenue, Product, and Marketing move together around key moments and decisions, from product launches to new market entry.

Equip our commercial teams to win

Drive launches as a system
Lead product launches and key market moments end to end. Brief and align all teams involved, ensure consistency across every touchpoint, and feed learnings back into product decisions.
Secure AI leadership
Strenghten and strategically expand our AI positioning as hospitality enters the age of Agentic AI - where autonomous agents handle everything from revenue optimisation to guest communication.

A genuine curiosity for new technology, particularly AI, and an appetite to stay ahead of where the market is heading

Background in hospitality tech or a working knowledge of how properties operate and make technology decisions, which shortens the path to real depth significantly

At the center of it is Felix, our AI teammate, which takes real work off a team's plate — running follow-up across calls, texts, and emails today, with more of the team's day-to-day work coming next. We're not another tool in the stack.

We're the system that powers it — learning, adapting, and executing in real time so teams can focus on growth, not guesswork. If you're excited about building an AI product that's changing how an entire industry works, you'll fit right in.

Company Description Playaway Products is a company built on a simple belief: that everyone should have access to the joy of stories and learning, without barriers. For more than 20 years, we’ve created thoughtfully designed technology that connects people to high-quality content from the world’s best publishers, developers, and studios.

What started with a single pre-loaded audiobook player has grown into a family of products built for institutional circulation, where reliability, ease of use, and trust matter as much as innovation. We design for real-world conditions and make deliberate tradeoffs to prioritize access, durability, and ease of use over flash or novelty.

Today, we serve public libraries, schools, the military, and other institutional circulation markets. The work we do shows up every day in the lives of readers and learners often in places where equitable access to technology and learning matters most.

As our products and partnerships grow, so does the opportunity to shape what access to learning looks like next. At Playaway, discovery begins with curiosity, and our culture values ownership, collaboration, and responsibility.

This is a place for people who care about impact, are comfortable navigating ambiguity, and want to help build what comes next. s.t:
Radiology Partners , through its owned and affiliated practices, is a leading radiology practice in the U.S., serving hospitals and other healthcare facilities across the nation.

As a physician-led and physician-owned practice, our mission is to transform radiology by innovating across clinical value, technology, service, and economics, while elevating the role of radiology and radiologists in healthcare.

Using a proven healthcare services model, Radiology Partners provides consistent, high-quality care to patients, while delivering enhanced value to the hospitals, clinics, imaging centers and referring physicians we serve.

Lead enterprise product positioning and messaging for RP’s technology portfolio, including AI-enabled offerings, ensuring a clear, differentiated narrative that aligns to growth priorities and strengthens market credibility.
Develop and evolve product and solution narratives (including clinical, technology, and AI-enabled capabilities), translating features into buyer-relevant value propositions, proof points, and outcomes.
Define and maintain product marketing frameworks (personas, use cases, messaging hierarchies, and solution taxonomy) that enable consistent interpretation and application across teams and channels.
Build future-facing platform stories and go-to-market narratives that increase relevance, resonance, and adoption—positioning RP’s technology offerings as category leaders.
Own go-to-market strategy for new products and major releases, partnering with product, sales, and growth teams to define target segments, ideal customer profiles (ICPs) and personas, use cases, packaging assumptions, and launch objectives.
Establish launch governance and operating rhythms (intake, prioritization, cross-functional planning, resourcing, and timelines), ensuring launches are aligned to enterprise priorities and executed with speed, quality, and rigor.
Define launch readiness standards (core messaging, demo storyline, web and campaign inputs, sales enablement, and success metrics) and use stakeholder feedback and performance results to drive continuous improvement.
Oversee development of a sales enablement strategy and roadmap that equips Sales, Client, and partner-facing teams to articulate product value consistently and win in competitive cycles.
Set clear enablement expectations and KPIs (e.g., content adoption, training completion, pipeline influence, win/loss insights); review results regularly, remove barriers, and ensure continuous optimization.
Oversee sales enablement governance, including prioritization, content quality standards, and tool/channel strategy (e.g., playbooks, battlecards, FAQs, demo scripts), ensuring accuracy, compliance, and field usability.
Lead customer and market insight efforts (voice of customer (VOC), buyer interviews, win/loss, usage and adoption signals) to sharpen go-to-market strategy and improve product-market fit.
Partner with Product and Sales to develop competitive intelligence (landscape, differentiation, battlecards, objection handling) that improves sales effectiveness and informs roadmap priorities.
Own analyst and category narrative inputs in partnership with Marketing & Communications; ensure consistent messages across PR, awareness, demand, and sales materials.
Support pricing and packaging strategy by providing market context, value metrics, willingness-to-pay insights, and packaging recommendations; partner on tests and iteration as offerings evolve.
Partner with executives, product, clinical, and marketing teams to develop compelling points of view, narratives, and proof points (e.g., articles, keynote storylines, webinars, reports, and customer stories) that build credibility and demand.

Define and report on KPIs and dashboards for product marketing impact (e.g., launch outcomes, pipeline influence, enablement adoption, competitive win rates, and messaging performance); use insights to optimize strategy and demonstrate value to stakeholders.
Work closely with the SVP, Marketing & Communications and cross-functional executive leaders to establish effective collaboration, drive clarity on priorities, and improve go-to-market execution velocity and quality.

Bachelor’s degree in marketing, business, or a related field.
12+ years of progressive product marketing, solutions marketing, and/or go-to-market leadership experience in B2B technology; including 5+ years of people leadership.
Proven success commercializing technology products and/or platforms; experience with AI/ML-enabled solutions strongly preferred.
Demonstrated experience leading go-to-market strategy and product launches for new products and major releases.
Experience owning positioning, messaging, competitive differentiation, and sales enablement in a complex, multi-stakeholder organization. Experience partnering with cross-functional teams and managing agency/vendor relationships, budgets, timelines, and quality across multiple concurrent launches and go-to-market initiatives.

LemFi (Series B) is building the go-to financial app for the Global South.
Moving to a new country shouldn’t mean starting from zero. That's why our team of 400+ spanning 20+ countries is building a financial ecosystem that helps immigrants stay connected to home, build stability, and create wealth regardless of where they are from or where they live.
What began as fast, affordable remittances is now evolving into a complete platform for multi-currency accounts, payments, credit, and long-term financial growth.
With millions of users across the globe, we process over $1B in monthly transactions to 30+ countries, proving that borders shouldn't limit financial opportunity.

CRM at LemFi doesn't run on batch and blast. As Senior CRM Manager - Automations, you'll own the lifecycle journeys that carry a customer from first sign-up to their tenth product, across remittance, credit, savings and the insurance products coming next. This is the person who builds onboarding, retention, reactivation, referral and cross-sell journeys that adapt to real customer behaviour, not a calendar.
You'll sit close to Product, Data and Growth, and report directly into the Head of CRM. Your journeys are core infrastructure for the business. Get them right and every other campaign, product launch and market entry gets easier.
What you’ll build and own
Design and own the lifecycle journeys, onboarding, retention, reactivation, that run without you touching them daily.
Build referral and virality programmes that turn customers into the acquisition channel.
Launch cross-sell journeys that introduce customers to credit, savings and insurance at the right moment, not the loudest one.
Set up the triggers, segments and logic that make each journey react to real behaviour.
Test, measure and iterate. Kill what doesn't move the number, scale what does.
Partner with Product and Data to get the event tracking and attributes your journeys actually need.
Report on lifecycle performance in numbers a CMO can act on, not a dashboard nobody opens.

4+ years in CRM, lifecycle or marketing automation, ideally in fintech or another high-frequency product.
Proficiency with Liquid language for dynamic, personalised content across journeys.
Hands-on expertise in a major marketing automation platform ( Customer.io , Braze, Iterable or similar). You build the journey yourself, you don't just brief it.
A track record of onboarding, retention or reactivation programmes you can point to, and the numbers they moved.
Comfortable with SQL and event-based data models. You query the data behind your own journeys.
Experience building referral or virality mechanics is a strong plus.
Judgment on trigger logic and segmentation that holds up across multiple products and markets.
Bias to ship and test over perfecting a brief.
Comfort with AI tools for content generation and personalisation at scale.
Familiarity with a BI or analytics tool such as Looker, Amplitude or Mixpanel for self-serve reporting.

Lived experience or deep empathy with the life of our users, the millions who move countries to build something better.
Language skills in French, Spanish, Italian, Portuguese, Wolof or Swahili.
Experience with WhatsApp or SMS as a lifecycle channel.
Background in remittance, cross-border payments or diaspora-focused products.
Experience designing loyalty or points-based programmes, beyond straight referral.
Experience operating in a regulated or compliance-sensitive comms environment.

Upbound is redefining how modern infrastructure is built for the Agentic AI Era. We’re the creators and primary maintainers of Crossplane , and we’re building the Intelligent Control Plane —a new platform layer that makes infrastructure programmable, autonomous, and composable .
Our mission is to power the AI-native enterprise with a foundational platform layer that helps teams provision, operate, and adapt infrastructure at scale—so platforms are ready for both humans and AI agents . We partner with leading cloud providers, ISVs, and open-source communities to help organizations move faster with greater confidence.
Today, Upbound supports Fortune 500 companies and platform engineers across 100+ countries . Crossplane has surpassed 100M+ downloads and is used by 1,000+ teams worldwide . We’re a Series B company backed by GV (formerly Google Ventures), Altimeter Capital, and Intel Capital , and we’ve raised $69M to date. Learn more at upbound.io
Upbound builds control planes for cloud and AI infrastructure. We created Crossplane and donated it to the CNCF, where it is a graduated project used by platform teams around the world. We are applying that same model to AI inference. Upbound is hiring a Senior Product Marketing Manager that will own go-to-market for that work.

You will help define how enterprises understand our commercial product and our open source roots. The community narrative and the enterprise narrative have to reinforce each other without collapsing into each other.

We are looking for someone who has done enterprise product marketing in growth stages and who is familiar with the Pragmatic Marketing discipline. You will need to be customer obsessed and be able to talk to a platform engineer to a VP of Engineering and VP of AI and who has worked inside an open core company.
In this role you will...
Positioning and messaging for our AI inference portfolio. The message architecture, the value framework, and the proof behind every claim we make.
Competitive and market strategy. You track the AI inference and infrastructure landscape, arm the field, and hold a defensible point of view on where the category is going.
Launches, end to end. Narrative and press through analyst briefings through sales enablement, on a release cadence measured in weeks rather than quarters.
Enterprise buyer fluency. Persona and journey work for CIOs, VPs of Engineering, VPs of AI, and the platform teams who evaluate us.
Sales enablement sellers actually use. Sales plays, discovery questions, objection handling, cost and ROI models, customer stories.
Pricing and packaging input , grounded in how enterprises actually buy and budget for AI infrastructure.
The open source to commercial path. The relationship between what the project does and what the product does, and the narrative that differentiates each.
Customer obsessed. You are a named spokesperson. You brief analysts, prep executives, and show up on stage, on podcasts, and in the community.
You are a good fit if you have...
8+ years in B2B enterprise software product marketing , with meaningful time on infrastructure, developer, or data platform products sold to technical buyers.
Enterprise go-to-market that closed real revenue. You can describe deals your messaging influenced, the buyer roles in the room, and what changed because of the work you did.
Genuine technical depth. Working knowledge of AI and Inference, cloud infrastructure, and how modern software gets deployed and operated, with awareness of the Kubernetes ecosystem.
Open source and commercial experience in the same organization. You have marketed a project and a product side by side. You understand community trust, the open core line, contributor and maintainer dynamics.
Zero to one in an emerging category. You have taken a new, technically ambitious product to market before the analysts had a name for it.
Writing you did yourself. You ship copy.
Comfort with speed and ambiguity. Our releases ship in weeks. The AI infrastructure market is moving quickly.
Trust with engineers, and senior sales leaders.
A plus if you…
Direct experience marketing AI or ML infrastructure, including inference serving, GPU capacity, or MLOps.
Fluency in the CNCF and/or PyTorch ecosystem
Hyperscaler or cloud marketplace route-to-market experience (AWS, Azure, GCP).
Training in a value messaging discipline such as Command of the Message, or an equivalent framework you have actually operationalized.
You have been the first or only PMM on a product and built the function from nothing.

Why Upbound?
At Upbound, you’ll help shape the systems and strategies that drive predictable, scalable growth in a product-led company embracing usage-based models. If you're excited to build from the ground up, work with cutting-edge cloud technologies, and directly impact how revenue is generated and scaled—this is your seat at the table.
About Upbound
Upbound is pioneering infrastructure platforms for the Agentic AI Era, serving Fortune 500 companies and platform engineers across more than 100 countries.

The company empowers infrastructure and platform teams with Intelligent Control Planes - based on Kubernetes and Crossplane - that provision, operate, and adapt so platforms are ready for both humans and AI agents.

Upbound is the creator and primary maintainer of Crossplane, the popular open-source framework for building cloud-native control planes, with over 100 million downloads and adoption by more than 1,000 teams worldwide. A Series B startup backed by GV (formerly Google Ventures), Altimeter Capital, and Intel Capital, Upbound has raised $69M to date.

For more information, visit www.upbound.io .

Hi 👋 I'm Chris. I'm a Lead Product Marketing Manager at hx - I joined over four years ago as a Product Marketing Manager. Outside of work you'll find me playing sport (badly), watching reality TV, or taking my dog Lucky to the park (or the pub!).
Product Marketing at hx is a highly strategic function. We shape the company's positioning and messaging, decide where and when products launch, and build the process that gets them to market.
This role comes with deep ownership over how we address our core audience: actuaries. You’ll need to go deep into the life and workflow of highly technical users and develop messaging, positioning, and content that neatly conveys the benefits of our solution.
You'll need to be comfortable managing senior stakeholders and have great taste - but what matters most is drive, and a willingness to solve problems as you find them. In return, you'll join a team that's kind, supportive, and full of very smart people who want to go fast and far. If that sounds like you, read on!
About hyperexponential (hx)
At hyperexponential, we're building the AI-powered platform that enables the world's most critical decisions in a £7 trillion industry, which risks to take, and how to price them. These are the decisions that shape real-world outcomes: whether rockets successfully launch into space, autonomous vehicles make it to market, or communities recover after major storms.
Until now, insurance has been making billion-pound decisions using outdated tools. We're changing that. Our platform brings together data, AI, and human expertise to give insurers the fastest path from submission to decision - helping them move faster, act smarter, and take on more risk with confidence.
Backed by a16z, Highland Europe, and Battery Ventures, we're scaling globally - already trusted by nearly 50 of the world's largest insurers, with zero churn and billions in premiums flowing through hx.
What began as a single product in one market has rapidly evolved into a multi-product, multi-territory platform powering every stage of pricing and underwriting. AI is at the core of what we do - from building the world's first domain-specific AI peer programmer for insurance (think GitHub Copilot with a PhD in actuarial science) to shaping agentic workflows that reinvent how this industry operates.
What makes hx different is the people who build it. Here, impact isn't tied to title or tenure; it's defined by the challenges you take on and the discipline you bring. Surrounded by peers who stretch you, you'll do the best, hardest work of your life in a company engineered to endure.
If that sounds like you, join us in building what comes next.

Marketing at hx operates at the intersection of demand generation, systems thinking, and constrained markets. We build authority and demand in a highly technical, niche space where every account matters. This isn't template-driven volume work - it's deep, strategic B2B marketing crafted for a known universe of accounts, and we stay involved from first engagement through to customer success.
As Product Marketing Manager for Calculation Engines and Portfolio Intelligence, you'll sit at the heart of how hx becomes the obvious choice for actuaries who want to price faster and steer their portfolio with confidence.

You'll own the technical story for our developer community - the most demanding audience we serve - and be the connective tissue between Product, Revenue, and the AI team, turning user insight into sharp positioning, useful sales assets, and narratives that stand up to scrutiny from people who'll know immediately if they don't.

Your work spans two distinct challenges at once: deepening engagement and value realisation for our established Calculation Engines product, whilst driving launch readiness, early adoption, and strong feedback loops for Portfolio Intelligence.
The team experiments constantly, uses AI to focus on strategy over busy work, and operates with a high bar for quality and pace. You'll be joining a group that takes work seriously but not themselves, where compressed learning is the norm and the most future-ready in your craft is the standard.
Check out our Marketing & GTM Engineering Candidate Hub for a behind the scenes look at the team you would be joining!
What you'll be doing
Drive deeper engagement and adoption of Calculation Engines among existing users, using the usage data we now have to spot where users stall and creating messaging and enablement that moves them forward.
Own go-to-market execution for the Portfolio Intelligence release end to end - positioning, launch materials, enablement, and user communications that get it in front of the right people and drive real usage.
Accelerate early adoption of Portfolio Intelligence by creating onboarding support and launch assets that help target users get to first value quickly, evidenced by users moving out of the beta programme into sustained use.
Become the developer community's champion by writing technical content at a regular cadence that Solutions Engineering uses in live deals, and answering architecture and integration questions directly rather than routing them to Product.
Build hx's position in actuarial AI by developing differentiated positioning and up-to-date competitive understanding that works consistently across website copy, enablement, and customer conversations.
Establish strong feedback loops between users, Product, Revenue, and the AI team, so insight from launches, testing, and field conversations directly informs messaging, prioritisation, and product direction.
What you'll need to have done
Led product marketing in a B2B SaaS environment, balancing adoption work for an existing product with launch readiness for a new one at the same time - demonstrating commercial judgement across multiple GTM motions.
Increased engagement or adoption of a mature product by using user insight to sharpen messaging or enablement - with measurable improvement in usage, understanding, or qualitative feedback from users and revenue teams.
Owned a product launch end to end, including the internal readiness and enablement work that happens before it ships - not just the moment it goes out.
Turned a complex technical capability into credible, differentiated messaging for a skeptical, technical audience - developers or an equivalent evaluator population - built on real user insight rather than generic claims.
Worked hands-on alongside a Solutions Engineer or equivalent technical partner, comfortable being challenged on technical detail and holding your line, and earning trust across Product, Engineering, and Revenue without relying on formal authority.
Used AI with real judgement about when a technical claim is actually true rather than just plausible, and applied that judgement to rebuild how systems like enablement, competitive intelligence, or win/loss work - not just run them faster.
You're unlikely to thrive here if
You expect full product maturity, clear roadmaps, and well-defined processes before taking action - hx moves fast and requires comfort operating in ambiguity where products, priorities, and messaging are still evolving.
